1.title: Product and process development
1.text: We take part in product and process development.

2.title: Prototype manufacturing
2.text: We manufacture prototypes to validate the part before moving to series production.

3.title: Approval
3.text: We approve the product and the process (homologation).

4.title: Tooling manufacturing
4.text: We manufacture the tooling required, which shortens manufacturing lead times.

5.title: Series production
5.text: We manufacture in series, in China.

6.title: Quality control
6.text: We have quality control equipment, such as measuring equipment and a hardness tester.

8.title: Buffer warehouse
8.text: Our warehouses in Amorebieta and Barcelona regulate the logistics flow of the products we supply in Spain.
